y: Y is a silvery metallic element that is common in rare-earth minerals.
Y can also mean the 25th letter of the Roman alphabet.
Y means the same as yttrium or atomic number 39 or wye.
y-axis: A y-axis is the vertical axis in a plane coordinate system.
y-linked gene: Y-linked gene is a gene located on a Y chromosome.
Y-linked gene means the same as holandric gene.
y2k: Y2K is the year 2000 in the Gregorian calendar.
y chromosome: Y chromosome is the sex chromosome that is carried by men.
For example: "Human males normally have one X chromosome and one Y chromosome."
y-shaped: Y-shaped means shaped in the form of the letter Y.
y2k compliant: Y2K compliant means prepared to accurately process date and time data between and into the 20th and 21st centuries.
